task_title: AUG-121: model each Auger task as a scoped XML spec with in/out references, acceptance+verification refs and ch:trace links
task_criteria: AC1 - a task XML block's stable id, lifecycle/version, in-scope refs, out-of-scope refs with reasons, acceptance refs and verification methods are typed and resolve to existing blocks. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_task_scope_contract. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or pytest reports fewer than 1 passed.

AC2 - duplicate, missing, inactive-without-acknowledgment and cross-version spec references are refused with a typed finding naming the exact task and block ids and emitting no partial task packet. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_task_naming_a_missing_block_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_multiple_scope_refusals_are_typed tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_inactive_reference_needs_acknowledgment tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_cross_version_reference_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_out_of_scope_entry_without_a_reason_is_refused. FAILIF: any of the five tests fails or skips, or fewer than 5 pass.

AC3 - given an approved plan digest, exporting one task through boardctl records the exact in-scope and excluded block ids plus their source version in supported fields and the readback matches, with boardctl present on the proof PATH. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS (a skip means the boardctl readback never ran), or the readback differs from the approved packet.

AC4 - given an unapproved or stale plan digest, boardctl is not invoked and both canonical JSONL files stay byte-identical. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or a canonical JSONL hash changes.

AC5 - a task packet's ch:trace marker resolves row and spec to the canonical task and exact XML ids, while absent evidence/verdict/commit fields use none:reason. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_generated_trace_marker_resolves. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or a marker field is missing instead of carrying none:reason.

AC6 - out of scope holds: the exporter invokes only boardctl create/readback with no scheduler mutation client, and its proof file is named in the gate pytest arm. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_gate_arm_runs_these_files. FAILIF: either test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or tests/gate.sh does not name tests/test_xml_task_contract.py.

items.criterion: AC1 - a task XML block's stable id, lifecycle/version, in-scope refs, out-of-scope refs with reasons, acceptance refs and verification methods are typed and resolve to existing blocks. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=... python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_task_scope_contract. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or pytest reports fewer than 1 passed.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof command: exit 0, output ".  [100%]\n1 passed in 0.78s" (not skipped, collected). The test (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:196-278) asserts the packet's typed fields (task/source/status/version/method/scope_version), typed in_scope/acceptance/out_of_scope records each carrying kind/status/version/source/edge, the exclusion reason ("owned by a later wave"), and cross-checks every named id against `spec list` output (named <= known) so refs resolve to real blocks. Backing implementation: auger.py:9538 task_packet / _task_packet_entry (auger.py:9522) and the XSD taskType with in-scope/out-of-scope/acceptance/acknowledges/scope-version/plan-digest attributes plus <exclusion ref reason> (specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd:236-262).

items.criterion: AC2 - duplicate, missing, inactive-without-acknowledgment and cross-version spec references are refused with a typed finding naming the exact task and block ids and emitting no partial task packet. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=... python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_task_naming_a_missing_block_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_multiple_scope_refusals_are_typed tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_inactive_reference_needs_acknowledgment tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_cross_version_reference_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_out_of_scope_entry_without_a_reason_is_refused. FAILIF: any of the five tests fails or skips, or fewer than 5 pass.
items.detail: Ran the exact five-test proof command: exit 0, output ".....  [100%]\n5 passed in 7.67s" (5 passed, none skipped). Each test asserts exit code 2, empty stdout ("a refusal emitted a partial verdict/packet"), and a typed code naming task+block: unresolved-reference (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:283-300), task-duplicate-reference / task-scope-conflict / task-invalid-acceptance-ref (:303-330), inactive-reference-unacknowledged incl. the lifecycle word "deprecated" (:333-365), cross-version-reference naming both 2.0.0 and 1.0.0 (:368-385), missing-exclusion-reason + unexpected-exclusion (:388-420). Implementation: auger.py:8598 _spec_validate_tasks raises each typed SpecError with task_id and ref; the packet verb refuses too because load_spec_corpus validates before task_packet (auger.py:9876-9890).

items.criterion: AC3 - given an approved plan digest, exporting one task through boardctl records the exact in-scope and excluded block ids plus their source version in supported fields and the readback matches, with boardctl present on the proof PATH. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=... python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS (a skip means the boardctl readback never ran), or the readback differs from the approved packet.
items.detail: boardctl is on the proof PATH: `shutil.which('boardctl')` -> /home/kara/.local/bin/boardctl. Ran the exact proof command: exit 0, "1 passed in 2.32s" — no skip, so the boardctl readback really ran. The test (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:466-520) exports with --plan-digest, then reads back via `boardctl show` and asserts capability_tags == ["in-scope:SG7-REQ-1@1.0.0","acceptance:SG7-AC-1@1.0.0","out-of-scope:SG7-REQ-9@1.0.0"], the canonical packet JSON verbatim inside reasoning, row['reasoning'] == result['readback']['reasoning'], exactly one row, and an idempotent re-export reporting "unchanged". Implementation: auger.py:9876 export_task_packet (create + show, readback mismatch -> board-readback-mismatch) and auger.py:9843 task_board_row.

items.criterion: AC4 - given an unapproved or stale plan digest, boardctl is not invoked and both canonical JSONL files stay byte-identical. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=... python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or a canonical JSONL hash changes.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof command (with -rs, in a batch of 5): exit 0, "5 passed in 0.28s", no skip lines reported. The test (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:524-580) hashes tasks.jsonl and events.jsonl before/after, asserts exit 2 with unapproved-plan-digest, stale-plan-digest (naming the stale digest) and invalid-plan-digest, empty stdout, `after == before` for both hashes, and that the recording boardctl wrapper's log file does not exist (boardctl never invoked). Implementation order is the contract: auger.py:9876-9890 calls require_approved_plan (auger.py:9596) BEFORE any _boardctl call.

items.criterion: AC5 - a task packet's ch:trace marker resolves row and spec to the canonical task and exact XML ids, while absent evidence/verdict/commit fields use none:reason. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=... python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_generated_trace_marker_resolves. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or a marker field is missing instead of carrying none:reason.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof command (in the 5-test batch): exit 0, "5 passed in 0.28s", no skips. The test (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:583-630) parses the generated marker: row == SG7-TASK-1, spec == tasks.xml#SG7-TASK-1, test == tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_gate_runs_these_tests; evidence/verdict/commit each start with "none:" and len > 5; resolve_trace_marker returns blocks == [SG7-TASK-1], missing == [], scope ids {SG7-REQ-1, SG7-AC-1, SG7-REQ-9} each with source ending "#<id>"; a bare "none" raises SpecError code unexplained-absent-field. Implementation: auger.py:9636 render_task_trace_marker (defaults none:no-evidence-recorded / none:not-judged / none:not-implemented) and auger.py:9694 parse_trace_marker rejecting bare none; documented at docs/prd/xml-spec-graph.md:116,125.

items.criterion: AC6 - out of scope holds: the exporter invokes only boardctl create/readback with no scheduler mutation client, and its proof file is named in the gate pytest arm. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=... python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_gate_arm_runs_these_files. FAILIF: either test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or tests/gate.sh does not name tests/test_xml_task_contract.py.
items.detail: Ran the exact two-test proof command (in the 5-test batch): exit 0, "5 passed in 0.28s", no skips. test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:633-690) records boardctl argv through a wrapper and asserts operations == {"create","show"}, then inspects export_task_packet + _boardctl source for urllib/http.client/requests/socket/scheduler/tick. test_gate_arm_runs_these_files (:693-714) asserts the file is in gate.sh's pytest arm; independently confirmed: tests/gate.sh:206 lists tests/test_xml_task_contract.py in the `python3 -m pytest ...` arm. Implementation: auger.py:9807 _boardctl is the only subprocess call in the surface.

items.criterion: Derived: the new task-scope grammar is enforced by the shipped schema, so a task block with in-scope/out-of-scope/acknowledges/scope-version/plan-digest and <exclusion> children validates against specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd (not only by ad-hoc code).
items.detail: specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd:236-262 declares taskType extending blockType with in-scope/out-of-scope/acceptance/acknowledges/scope-version/plan-digest attributes and the <exclusion ref reason> element; the corpus fixtures in the proof tests are validated through auger.load_spec_corpus, which loads and enforces the schema (auger.py:8706). tests/test_xsd_conformance.py passes in the regression run ("109 passed in 6.77s").

items.criterion: Derived: the new verbs are reachable from the CLI entrypoint — `auger spec task-packet` and `auger spec task-export` are registered in argparse and dispatched, so the behaviour is not dead code reachable only from tests.
items.detail: auger.py:14154 registers the `task-packet` subparser (root, --task) and auger.py:14173 registers `task-export` (root, --task, --board, --plan-digest, --boardctl); auger.py:12674-12678 dispatches command == "task-packet" -> cmd_spec_task_packet and "task-export" -> cmd_spec_task_export, both reached through cmd_spec (auger.py:12620) which converts SpecError into `spec error (<code>)` on stderr with exit 2. The proof tests drive exactly this path via auger.main(["spec", ...]).

items.criterion: Derived: the change does not regress the neighbouring spec suites (context, task packet, plan approval, XSD conformance, xml specs) that share load_spec_corpus and the trace-marker helpers.
items.detail: Ran `pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py tests/test_spec_context.py tests/test_task_packet.py tests/test_plan_approval.py tests/test_xsd_conformance.py tests/test_xml_specs.py` -> exit 0, "109 passed in 6.77s".
